name: Data-read (inferred-sensitive) under a Condition, with an unrelated Deny
note: IAM-706 fixture matrix: DATA-READ witnesses the condition + deny cells. s3:ListBucket/s3:GetObject on an inferred-sensitive bucket (production-backup) is a scoped data-read capability; an aws:SourceVpc StringEquals Condition narrows it (confidence drops a notch) and an unrelated explicit Deny (s3:DeleteObject) is present but does not suppress the read. Must fire DATA-READ; must NOT fire DATA-EXFIL (scoped, not broad), WILDCARD-RESOURCE (read verbs, named resource), or DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION (the destructive action is a Deny, not an Allow grant).
